text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on a 
monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block
Technical Specification:
Batteries 2 x 6124 
 OPzS 3000 2V - 3000 Ah
D : 1.215 kg/I | C 10,vf = 1.8 V
The first draft is initiated by eng. Eman El Henawey, tested by eng. Wageh 
Khalil, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control eng. Adel El Naggar, accepted by eng. 
Ali Zahran, general manager & eng. Samir Abd El Gillil MDEPC. quality control 
general director, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawwan head sector of Nubaria 
power station and certified by eng. Mohammed Nageb quality control head 
sector
Safety 
Precautions
Work order must be issued
Wear safety gloves and clothes
Tools and 
Equipment
Suitable tool set
Digital voltmeter
Vacuum cleaner or blower brush
Hydrometer for electrolyte density measurement
Suitable tool set
Digital voltmeter
Vacuum cleaner or blower brush
Hydrometer for electrolyte density measurement
Work to be carried out
Check the cells electrolyte level
Clean it from air dust and dirty
Check the ventilation system
Measure the cells electrolyte density & voltage and record
Check the voltage of battery set 1 & 2
